stage: Concept artwork; not integrated. Platform icon sizing and safe areas need production export.

prompts.icon:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square app icon concept for LobsOfLove, an irreverent competitive tennis arcade game.
Create an exceptional custom typographic LOL emblem that feels like an underground sports arcade identity. Exact lettering "LOL", three huge tightly composed chunky italic letters, with the middle O rendered as a circular optic-yellow tennis ball with two authentic curved ivory tennis seams. The two Ls are warm ivory, muscular angular custom lettering, sculptural but predominantly flat graphic. All three letters must read unmistakably LOL at thumbnail size. A single sharp hot-pink speed slash behind the letters gives explosive forward motion. Midnight navy #0b0f1a full bleed background, optic yellow #d7f205, hot pink #ff3d7f, ivory #f4f1e6. Restrained distressed screenprint grain concentrated at edges; very crisp dominant silhouette. Strong designed negative space, centered safe zone, main mark occupies central 75 percent of square. Premium game identity, cocky and playful, not corporate. No heart motifs, no romance, no extra text, no rackets, no tiny decorative details, no mockup, no rounded outer frame, no watermark. Deliver one finished square artwork.
prompts.loading:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait mobile arcade tennis title/loading screen artwork for LobsOfLove, 1024x1536.
Create a spectacular graphic sports arcade title screen with a massive custom "LOL" wordmark occupying the upper third, ivory angular heavy italic L letters flanking an optic-yellow tennis ball O with authentic curved seams. Exact smaller subtitle directly below: "LobsOfLove". The letters must clearly read LOL. Below the logo an enormous foreshortened tennis ball rockets toward the viewer over a dramatically tilted midnight tennis court; a sharp hot-pink zigzag motion trail recedes to the far baseline. Court seen from a low dynamic angle, net visibly stretched across middle-distance, graphic impact shards and coarse halftone shadows convey speed. Ball is recognizably tennis with authentic seams and intense optic-yellow surface. Composition feels like a beautifully designed cult arcade game cover and risograph sports poster, bold simple graphic masses, rough ink edges, limited color printing, not glossy generic 3D. Palette midnight navy #0b0f1a, optic yellow #d7f205, hot pink #ff3d7f, warm ivory #f4f1e6. Keep bottom 18 percent dark and visually quiet for real loading UI. All lettering inset safely from edges. Competitive, irreverent, kinetic and funny through exaggerated scale. No hearts, no romance, no palms, no skyline, no photorealism, no neon bloom, no extra words or fake interface, no watermark. Full bleed finished portrait illustration.
